title: Técnicas de estudio (Primera parte)
author: Rosa Delia Rivera Villalba
school: IES Blas Cabrera Felipe Arrecife - Lanzarote (Islas Canarias)

description.en:
Two projects of activities to practice the techniques of study. The activities are distributed in different parts:
  • Concentration
  • Environment Study
  • Attitude
  • Techniques
  • Memory and reasoning
